title: Multi-leads Operational Snapshot — Weekly Staff Meeting
summary: Concise capture of cross-team leadership sync focused on operational priorities for the week, blockers that need escalation, and alignment on a near-term release and capacity changes.
attendees: Claire Moreno (owner, facilitator), Marisol Chen (Platform Eng lead), Rafael Ortega (Serving Runtime), Priya Nair (SRE), Liam O'Connor (Infra), Zoe Kim (Product - Console), plus short updates read from subteam reps
agenda: 1) Quick metric spike review 2) Release gating checklist for 2026.11.18 3) Incident retrospective highlights 4) Capacity plan for Dedicated cluster 5) Rollout and rollback guardrails 6) Open blockers and escalations 7) Parking lot
notes:
(1) Metrics snapshot: brief spike in tail-latency observed Wednesday 11/05 (p95 from 120ms -> 420ms for 30m). Root cause suspected: a combination of larger batch fan-in on Model-A variant and an autoscaler cooldown anomaly. Priya is leading a deep-dive; initial mitigation added a short cooldown and tightened batch-size cap. Action: prioritize a safe default batch cap in config.

(2) Release gating for 2026.11.18: target is to flip Dedicated autoscale policy for cluster-us-west-2 to new policy (policy-v2) that reduces cold-start latency. Marisol presented results from canary: median latency improvement ~18%, no regression on throughput. Two open items remain: e2e load test threshold flakiness and a migration script for instance labels. Decision: proceed with phased canary (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with rollback window of 2 hours. Rafael to own canary orchestration.

(3) Incident retrospective: recent S3 credential rotation caused a 22-minute elevated error window for private deployments in eu-west-1. Root cause was an out-of-band rotation performed without updating the deployment automation. We agreed on: a) enforce out-of-band-change policy; b) add a pre-rotation checklist on Confluence; c) expand alerting to include configuration diffs. Zoe to coordinate checklist content with Solutions Eng.

(4) Dedicated cluster capacity plan: anticipated spike from customer X (enterprise trial) starting 2026-11-20. Estimated extra 4k QPS sustained for 48 hours. Capacity options discussed: temporary burst nodes vs. upfront reserve. Fiscal trade-offs: burst is cheaper short-term but riskier for SLOs. Decision: pre-warm a modest buffer (2k QPS equivalent) and enable burst with strict throttling; finance sign-off required. Liam to produce a short cost-risk matrix by EOD 11/12.

(5) Rollout/rollback guardrails: agreed to codify automated rollback on error budget breach (10-minute sustained error rate > 2%). Rafael and Priya to sketch runbook; Claire to make it part of the release checklist.

(6) Open blockers: 
- PLAT-2781: Label migration script failing on node pools; blocker for full policy rollout. (Owner: Marisol) 
- INF-4123: KV cache invalidation edge-case causing rare duplication under heavy fan-in. (Owner: Rafael)
- DOCS-980: Missing instructions for private-deploy KMS integration. (Owner: Zoe)

(7) Parking lot: discuss a lightweight 'observability index' metric (cost-adjusted signal quality) in two weeks; also table longer-term batching research findings for next all-hands.
decisions: 1) Proceed with phased canary for policy-v2 with 2-hour rollback window. 2) Pre-warm 2k QPS capacity for customer X and enable controlled burst. 3) Add out-of-band-change policy, pre-rotation checklist, and alerting for config diffs. 4) Implement automated rollback on error-budget breaches as a required release guardrail.
action_items: Rafael Ortega: Orchestrate phased canary for policy-v2 (start 11/12) and own rollback automation. Linked: PLAT-2781.
Priya Nair: Complete deep-dive on Wednesday tail-latency spike; propose permanent batch-cap defaults by 11/14. Linked: INF-4123.
Liam O'Connor: Cost-risk matrix for burst vs reserve for customer X capacity (due 11/12).
Marisol Chen: Fix label migration script and unblock rollout (PLAT-2781). Update status in Jira by 11/11.
Zoe Kim: Draft S3 rotation pre-checklist and run it past Solutions Eng; update Confluence by 11/13 (DOCS-980).
Claire Moreno: Add automated rollback and the new checks into the release checklist; coordinate sign-off with Product and SRE by 11/15.
blockers: PLAT-2781: label migration script failures blocking policy rollout
INF-4123: KV cache invalidation edge-case under heavy fan-in
DOCS-980: KMS integration docs incomplete for private-deployments
risks: Short-term: incomplete label migration could delay the policy rollout and keep legacy autoscale behavior in production. Medium-term: capacity under-provisioning for customer X could impact SLAs. Operational: manual credential rotations without runbook cause avoidable incidents.

- Liam will circulate cost matrix and recommended approach by 11/12.
- Claire will schedule a 30-minute pre-release war room for 11/17.
- Zoe to publish rotation checklist by 11/13.
